extraTests.domain: All multiset skill arrays n,m=1..3 over 1..3 (361 inputs); exhaustive independent bipartite matching by used-girl bitmask.

192833840.reason: Counts each boy if any compatible girl exists without consuming that girl; allows multiple boys to reuse one partner and prints 4 instead of 3.

193255485.reason: Processes unsorted arrays and greedily prefers exact skill before skill-1/skill+1. List max/min is lexicographic, not sorting by skill; greedy consumption can strand a later participant. Counted input yields 71 instead of maximum 76.

193255934.reason: Same unsorted exact-first partner consumption through d/d1 aliases; choosing list max/min does not establish a safe ordered matching. Counted input yields 71 instead of 76.

193346019.reason: Greedily matches original input order without sorting or augmenting paths. On boys 6 3 4 and girls 4 5 2, it consumes 4 for boy 3, stranding boy 4; actual 2, optimum 3.

195171221.reason: Applies sequence-alignment DP to unsorted skill arrays, restricting matches to order-preserving pairs although arbitrary pairings are allowed. Actual 3, optimum 4 on counted test.
